## Content

Describe the item and its intended use. Link its directory and collection entry.

## Compatibility and verification

Record the application version or commit, import steps, and observed result.
For documentation-only changes, record the checks performed instead.

## Provenance and licensing

Identify the original source, author, license, and any modified or bundled assets.

- [ ] Links and relative asset paths resolve.
- [ ] Compatibility claims match actual verification.
- [ ] Attribution and license information are included.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, or unnecessary large files are included.
